title: Jennie climbs to No. 5 on Billboard Hot 100 with "Dracula"
text:
Jennie climbs to No. 5 on Billboard Hot 100 with "Dracula" - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 12일(목) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Jennie climbs to No. 5 on Billboard Hot 100 with "Dracula" 
 입력 2026.11.04. 13:36 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 Jenny of the group Blackpink reached the top 5 on the U.S. Billboard main singles chart.
 Jennie. /Courtesy of OA Entertainment News1 According to Billboard on the 3rd (local time), Jenny's "Dracula," a collaboration with Australian singer Tame Impala, rose three spots from the previous week to No. 5 on the main singles chart, the Hot 100.
 KATSEYE's "Animal" ranked No. 27 on the Hot 100.
 On the main albums chart, the Billboard 200, Blackpink's Lisa entered at No. 35 with the new album "Press Play," and KATSEYE's "Wild" ranked No. 38.
 BTS' fifth full-length album, "Arirang," rose to No. 57 and remained on the chart for 32 consecutive weeks.
